text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Greek Cypriot press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The United Nations resident representative in Cyprus is seeking gestures of goodwill between the Greek and Turkish Cypriot communities.
- (Right wing) Disy party vice chairman Nicos Anastassiades is expected to declare his bid to run for the presidency of the party in spite of any intent by incumbent Yiannakis Matsis.
- Who swiped the Swatches? Rare timepieces go missing from container.
- Trade unions in Cyprus look to a federal Cyprus in the European Union.
- (Turkish Cypriot leader Rauf) Denktash's attitude on EuroMP's request to visit enclaved Greekm Cypriots in Karpasia was "scandalous".
- Trade union Peo says "no" to President Glafcos Clerides's proposals for an adjustment of COLA (cost of living allowance) payments.
- The United Nations appear encouraged on the course of the proximity talks between the two sides in Cyprus, and seeks goodwill gestures from both.
- The crisis in Disy will have repercussions on President Clerides's chances of re-election, according to poll commissioned by Sigma television station.
